description: Price statistical trades in an approximate-circuit campaign as an explicit exchange market: fix a Toffoli-per-lambda rate, measure every trade paired against its parent with a standard error, charge conservative floors, scan for buybacks priced below the rate, and guard census-fitted tables against in-sample overfitting. Use whenever an ecdsa.fail-style circuit trades executed Toffoli for failure rate before a nonce grind, or any scored artifact trades score for a statistical defect rate.
